_about: DRAFT wording for cards and overlays, written to the 2026-11-27 middle-school standard (Orban's pictures decide; keep the defining beat, relax range). Long-term this text belongs in each exercise contract (specs/production-framework, PR #125). The V2 cue-card review in Drive may replace it.

opening.title: PICK A MISSION.
lines: 11 minutes of work. Go at your own pace.

1.title: TOE TOUCH
1.tip: Reach high, fold down, rise and lean back a little
cues: Small lean back at the top

2.title: PARTIAL SIT-UP
2.tip: Lift head and shoulders until you see your toes
cues: Lie on your back, legs straight
Small curl, then lie back down

3.title: LEG RAISE
3.tip: Lift your head and one leg, then switch
cues: Lie face down, palms under thighs
Count 1 when the second leg comes down

4.title: KNEE PUSH-UP
4.tip: Chest to the floor, then push to straight arms

5b.title: SCISSOR JUMPS
5b.tip: Opposite arm forward, switch legs in the air
